verses.greek: Ὅλως ἀκούεται ἐν ὑμῖν πορνεία, καὶ τοιαύτη πορνεία ἥτις οὐδὲ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὥστε γυναῖκά τινα τοῦ πατρὸς ἔχειν.
verses.literal: Actually is reported among you sexual immorality and such sexual immorality as not even among the pagans so as for the wife one of the father to have
verses.dgt: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and sexual immorality of a kind not even found among the Gentiles: a man has his father’s wife.

verses.greek: καὶ ὑμεῖς πεφυσιωμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἐπενθήσατε, ἵνα ἀρθῇ ἐκ μέσου ὑμῶν ὁ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο ποιήσας;
verses.literal: And you yourselves puffed up are and not rather mourned so that may be taken out of midst of you the one the deed this ποιήσας;
verses.dgt: And you are puffed up! Should you not rather have mourned, so that the one who did this deed might be removed from among you?

verses.greek: Ἐγὼ μὲν γάρ, ἀπὼν τῷ σώματι παρὼν δὲ τῷ πνεύματι, ἤδη κέκρικα ὡς παρὼν τὸν οὕτως τοῦτο κατεργασάμενον
verses.literal: I myself indeed though being absent the in body being present however the in spirit already have judged as being present the one so this having produced
verses.dgt: For I, though absent in body but present in spirit, have already judged, as though present, the one who has done this.

verses.greek: ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ, συναχθέντων ὑμῶν καὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ πνεύματος σὺν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν ⸁Ἰησοῦ,
verses.literal: in the name of the Lord our Jesus having been gathered together you and the me in spirit with the power of the Lord of us Jesus
verses.dgt: In the name of our Lord Jesus, when you are assembled and my spirit is with you, with the power of our Lord Jesus,

verses.greek: παραδοῦναι τὸν τοιοῦτον τῷ Σατανᾷ εἰς ὄλεθρον τῆς σαρκός, ἵνα τὸ πνεῦμα σωθῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ κυρίου.
verses.literal: to deliver the such a one the to Satan for destruction of the flesh so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord
verses.dgt: hand such a man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord.

verses.greek: Οὐ καλὸν τὸ καύχημα ὑμῶν. οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ;
verses.literal: Not good is the boasting of you. Not know you that a little leaven all the lump leavens?
verses.dgt: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole batch of dough?

verses.greek: ἐκκαθάρατε τὴν παλαιὰν ζύμην, ἵνα ἦτε νέον φύραμα, καθώς ἐστε ἄζυμοι. καὶ γὰρ τὸ πάσχα ἡμῶν ἐτύθη Χριστός·
verses.literal: do cleanse out the old leaven that you may be a new lump even as you are unleavened Also for the Passover lamb of us has been sacrificed Christ.
verses.dgt: Clean out the old leaven so that you may be a new batch of dough, just as you are unleavened. For Christ, our Passover, has also been sacrificed.

verses.greek: ὥστε ἑορτάζωμεν, μὴ ἐν ζύμῃ παλαιᾷ μηδὲ ἐν ζύμῃ κακίας καὶ πονηρίας, ἀλλʼ ἐν ἀζύμοις εἰλικρινείας καὶ ἀληθείας.
verses.literal: so that we may celebrate the feast not with leaven old not with leaven of malice and wickedness but with unleavened bread of sincerity and of truth.
verses.dgt: So then let us celebrate the feast, not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

verses.greek: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι πόρνοις,
verses.literal: I wrote to you in the letter not to associate with the sexually immoral
verses.dgt: I wrote to you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people—

verses.greek: οὐ πάντως τοῖς πόρνοις τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἢ τοῖς πλεονέκταις καὶ ἅρπαξιν ἢ εἰδωλολάτραις, ἐπεὶ ὠφείλετε ἄρα ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελθεῖν.
verses.literal: not at all with the sexually immoral the world of this or with the covetous and with swindlers or with idolaters — since you have been obliged then would from the world to depart.
verses.dgt: not meaning altogether the sexually immoral people of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters, since then you would have to leave the world.

verses.greek: νῦν δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι ἐάν τις ἀδελφὸς ὀνομαζόμενος ᾖ πόρνος ἢ πλεονέκτης ἢ εἰδωλολάτρης ἢ λοίδορος ἢ μέθυσος ἢ ἅρπαξ, τῷ τοιούτῳ μηδὲ συνεσθίειν.
verses.literal: now however I wrote to you not to associate with him if anyone a brother being designated he shall be sexually immoral or a coveter or an idolater or verbal abuser or a drunkard or swindler the with such a one not even to eat.
verses.dgt: But now I have written to you not to associate with anyone called a brother or sister who is sexually immoral or greedy or an idolater or a reviler or a drunkard or a swindler—not even to eat with such a person.

verses.greek: τί γάρ μοι τοὺς ἔξω κρίνειν; οὐχὶ τοὺς ἔσω ὑμεῖς κρίνετε,
verses.literal: What for is it to me those outside to judge? Surely those within you yourselves do judge?
verses.dgt: For what business is it of mine to judge those outside? Is it not those inside whom you judge?

verses.greek: τοὺς δὲ ἔξω ὁ θεὸς κρίνει; ἐξάρατε τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: Those however outside the God will judge? do yourselves expel the evil out from you them.
verses.dgt: But God judges those outside. Remove the wicked person from among yourselves.
